Hi Samir — great chat this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for AtlasLytics' real-time customer support summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria: (1) <= 150ms median latency at 10 QPS for 1k-token sequences, (2) <5% inference cost delta vs baseline, (3) parity on summary quality for 200 evaluation prompts (precision/recall style checks).
- Data sensitivity: logs will include customer PII; primary preference is isolated network (VPC) but open to hosted sandbox for an accelerated run if controls are acceptable.

POC / Evaluation plan (proposed):
1) Environment decision: Hosted sandbox (fastest) vs Dedicated sandbox vs VPC trial (most secure). We should pick this by EOD Monday.
2) Baseline run (week 1): ingest 200 eval prompts + 50 representative conversations.
3) Load validation (week 2): ramp to target QPS and measure latency/cost.
4) Quality evaluation (week 2-3): run the 200 prompt evals and capture diffs/retros.
5) Wrap & next steps (week 4): exec review, contract discussion.

Ownership / action items:
- AtlasLytics: confirm success criteria and which environment you prefer (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC).
- Redwood (Marissa): coordinate scheduling and commercial terms.

Attachments: POC checklist and environment options doc attached (see AtlasLytics_poc_checklist.xlsx).

Thanks for the ping — here's a quick feasibility summary. TL;DR: Hosted sandbox is fastest (same-day to 48 hours), VPC trial is straightforward but requires customer network inputs and roughly 3-5 business days for provisioning once inputs are provided.

VPC prerequisites (minimal):
- Allowed CIDR block(s) to peer (we prefer a /24 from customer side for routing simplicity).
- Public egress IP ranges to allow for admin access (if required).
- Ports: outbound HTTPS (443) required; if you want private peering, we support GRE/VPN/Direct Connect options depending on region.
- KMS/HSM: if Atlas wants customer-managed keys, we need the KMS ARN and KMS admin contact to set up access.
- Service account for provisioning with minimum IAM: ec2:Describe*, ec2:CreateTags, ec2:DescribeVpcs, iam:PassRole (we'll provide an exact policy).

Estimated lead times:
- Hosted sandbox: 0-2 business days (tokenization/masking recommended if PII present).
- VPC trial (standard path): 3-5 business days after receiving network inputs + signed connectivity SOW.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): depends on capacity and contract — typically 2-3 weeks.

Notes on data handling for hosted sandbox: we recommend Masking or Tokenization of PII before upload for hosted runs. If Atlas prefers, we can accept redacted samples and run the full PII flows in VPC only.

I've attached the redwood_vpc_onboarding_guide.pdf with the full checklist and a sample IAM policy. If you want, I can draft the exact policy and a template SOW for legal.

Let me know and I'll slot time for a technical kickoff with Atlas.

— Dev
